question: Our receipts for this CRM subscription keep going to my old manager who left in July. How do I get them sent to me instead?

articles.title: Change your billing email
articles.body:
Your **Billing email** is where Harbour CRM sends your subscription receipts.

1. Go to **Settings** > **Client profile**.
2. Replace the address in **Billing email**.
3. Select **Save client profile**.

answer:
Subscription receipts are sent to your **Billing email**, so change that to your address:

1. Go to **Settings** > **Client profile**.
2. Replace the address in **Billing email**.
3. Select **Save client profile**.
